candidate.name: Riffle DP g=4
candidate.modification_policy: Any change to a mathematical field below requires a distinct candidate name and a new manifest.

claim_under_study.random_variable: Z_d counts nonzero messages whose forward encoded word has Hamming weight at most d.

field.basis: polynomial basis, bit i is the coefficient of x^i

local_code.name: extended primitive narrow-sense BCH [128,64,22]
local_code.encoding: For message polynomial m, coordinates 0..126 are m(x)g(x); coordinate 127 is their parity.

layout.outer_binary_layout: The 128 coordinates of each local word are contiguous, in outer symbol order.
layout.packet_layout: Consecutive four-bit groups of the sequential outer binary layout.

ensemble.sample_space: All bijections from 524352 logical packet positions to 524352 physical outer packets.
ensemble.packet_order_semantics: packet_order[j] is the physical outer packet gathered at logical inner packet position j
ensemble.implementation_sampler_scope: init(seed) is a finite-seed implementation adapter and is not the exact theorem-facing uniform distribution on the symmetric group.
ensemble.exact_conditional_interface: initOrder(packet_order) realizes the binary matrix for a specified bijection.

inner_map.step: Gather the node's 16 packets through packet_order, apply the extended-BCH systematic packet transpose state step, write the result to the same physical packets, and use that result as the next state.
inner_map.matrix_orientation: The forward code matrix is the transpose of the implemented composite transpose map: inner transpose followed by outer transpose.

derived_terminal_event.event: All nonzero outer packets occupy the final 2949 logical inner nodes.

verification.source_compile: The RiffleCode_Tests.cpp and UnitTests.cpp object targets compile under x64-Debug.
verification.runtime_test: Passed: symbolic basis batches establish the local BCH kernel, packet-four inner kernel, and every x^i coefficient recurrence; one full-size explicit-order input also matched independent inner and outer references.
